edges.fact: UC Berkeley offers an International Student Orientation program to help new international students meet others, get familiar with campus, and learn about university resources
The Student Union is a student service and resource at UC Berkeley that organizes events including concerts, comedy shows, and cultural festivals
The Recreational Sports Facility is a student service and resource available on the UC Berkeley campus
The Tang Center provides health and counseling services on the UC Berkeley campus
The International Office at UC Berkeley organizes welcome events and provides support for homesickness and culture shock

UC Berkeley offers a Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) that meets the university's minimum health insurance requirements for international students, covering medical, mental health, prescription, vision, dental, repatriation, and medical evacuation benefits

edges.source_entity_name: UC Berkeley Student Health Insurance Office
edges.fact: The UC Berkeley Student Health Insurance Office provides information about SHIP enrollment and waiver processes and deadlines
English Language Support Services (ELSS) at UC Berkeley provides language support including instruction, conversation practice, and academic language support for international students
The Berkeley English Language Proficiency Requirement (BEPR) is a language proficiency assessment required for non-native English speaking international students at UC Berkeley
The UC Berkeley Photography Club organizes photo walks, workshops, and exhibitions for photography enthusiasts on campus
The Cal Corps Public Service Center at UC Berkeley is a hub for community service and volunteer opportunities, offering programs, events, and resources
Alternative Breaks is a UC Berkeley program organizing service trips during academic breaks focused on issues like environmental conservation, education, and social justice
The UC Berkeley Student Organization Directory lists over 1,200 student organizations covering academic, cultural, hobby, and community-service interests
Cal Performances is a UC Berkeley performing arts series featuring world-class music, dance, and theater performances

edges.source_entity_name: UC Berkeley Art Museum and Pacific Film Archive
edges.fact: The UC Berkeley Art Museum and Pacific Film Archive showcases diverse art exhibitions and cinematic works on campus
Cal Athletics hosts Golden Bears games at UC Berkeley, including football and basketball
The Golden Bears are the sports teams represented under Cal Athletics at UC Berkeley
The Berkeley International Festival is a cultural festival celebrating diversity at UC Berkeley
African American Culture Week is a cultural festival celebrating diversity at UC Berkeley
Dia de los Muertos is celebrated as a cultural festival at UC Berkeley
San Francisco International Airport (SFO) is the arrival airport for the user's flight to San Francisco
BART (plus a connecting bus) is a public transportation option departing from San Francisco International Airport
BART (plus a connecting bus) is a public transportation option arriving at UC Berkeley from San Francisco International Airport
Bayporter Express is a shuttle service departing from San Francisco International Airport
Bayporter Express is a shuttle service arriving at UC Berkeley from San Francisco International Airport
F-1 students must present their I-20 form along with their passport and visa at the immigration checkpoint
